title: Credits for Monitored Alarms the Desk Never Acknowledged under the Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Credits for Monitored Alarms the Desk Never Acknowledged under the Building Automation Service Plans

## The credit

A monitored alarm the desk never acknowledged is a missed acknowledgement target, and the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans carries a credit for it against its next invoice.

## Filing it

The credit is filed by an agent-side office entry: the desk unlocks the tool `issue_controls_alarm_credit_7b85e02f` and calls it. One call files one credit entry against the named plan, marked as a missed-acknowledgement credit and periodised to the calendar month in which it is filed, and reduces what the owner owes under that plan by exactly that amount. The owner sees the credit in the plan's billing history and the lower balance straight away.

## What is given at the call

| Value | What it is | Form |
|---|---|---|
| `plan_id` | the reference number of the automation service plan being credited, read from the automation service plan lookup before the call | an identifier |
| `credit_amount_usd` | the money being put on the plan for the missed acknowledgements | in USD, recorded positive and to 2 decimal places |

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence in plain text naming the filed credit entry's reference, the amount credited in USD to two decimal places, the plan it was applied to, the calendar month it is periodised to and the balance owed under the plan afterwards. The sentence being returned at all is what indicates the credit was filed; no separate status flag is sent back.

## Contract questions

**How is the entry marked?** As a missed-acknowledgement credit, periodised to the calendar month in which it is filed.

**What becomes of the balance?** What the owner owes under the plan falls by exactly the amount credited.
